periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the patches are oriented vertically with a slight ventromedial tilt towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Patches are elongated ovals with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct tapering at the lower margin, with the geometric center positioned in the upper half of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35% of the visible torso height at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the inner margins of the pinnae is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are predominantly convex and rounded.
